$comment: Written by npm run schemas from core/schema. Change the definition there, not this file.
title: The map between hosts
description: A console's subscription to another host's map, and that host's answers: the SSH relay's frames, sealed between the two hosts.

op.description: From the subscribing host. open: start, with a hello and a snapshot; get: one read from the relay's allowlist, as GET; time: the host's clock; renew: still watching (every 20 s; a subscription lapses after 60 s without one), with fresh for a new snapshot after a gap; close: stop

sub.description: The subscription, made at random by the subscribing host

id.description: For get and time: the console's question, which the answer's res or time frame names

path.description: For get: the path and query to read

fresh.description: For renew: send a fresh snapshot, since frames were lost

sub.description: The subscription, made at random by the subscribing host

seq.description: 1, 2, 3… within the subscription: a hole means frames were lost, and the console asks for a fresh snapshot
